parts.article_title: Why not visit Wales and go to a festival?

paragraphs.text: A Winter Food and Craft Festival
paragraphs.translation: 冬季美食与手工艺节

paragraphs.text: Our ever-popular Winter Food and Craft Festival is back! This year it's going to be bigger and better than ever, The event will host a variety of stalls, selling items ranging from fashion and personal ornaments, including beautiful necklaces or earrings, to handmade gifts, There will also be a large seating area where visitors can enjoy some of the hot and cold ready-to-eat delights on offer.
paragraphs.translation:
我们备受欢迎的冬季美食与手工艺节回来了！
今年它将比以往任何时候都更大、更精彩。
该活动将设有各种摊位，出售从时尚饰品和个人装饰品（包括精美的项链或耳环）到手工礼物的商品。
还将设有一个大型休息区，游客可以在那里享用现场提供的各种热食和冷食即食美味。

paragraphs.text: B Other Voices
paragraphs.translation: B 其他声音

paragraphs.text: On 1st and 2nd November, Other Voices makes its way from its home in Dingle on the west coast of Ireland to the town of Cardigan on the west coast of Wales, for a phenomenal weekend which celebrates the longstanding cultural and musical ties between these regions. Over the weekend we will showcase a line-up of over 30 free musical and cultural events, featuring incredible vocal performances.
paragraphs.translation:
11月1日和2日，其他声音活动将从其位于爱尔兰西海岸丁格尔的故乡移至威尔士西海岸的卡迪根镇，举办一个非凡的周末，庆祝这两个地区之间长期存在的文化和音乐联系。
在整个周末，我们将展示超过30场免费音乐和文化活动的阵容，其中包含令人惊叹的声乐表演。

paragraphs.text: C Festival of Senses
paragraphs.translation: C 感官节

paragraphs.text: Festival of Senses is an annual free festival in the West Wales town of Llandeilo. It offers craft and fashion stalls, food stalls and more. The Country Market will be open all day on Friday and Saturday. Do visit us for light snacks and to view our wide range of goods, all produced in the area by our cooks, crafters and growers.
paragraphs.translation:
感官节是位于西威尔士兰代洛镇的一年一度的免费节庆活动。
它设有手工艺品和时尚摊位、食品摊位等。
乡村市场将在周五和周六全天开放。
请务必前来品尝小吃，并浏览我们种类繁多的商品，这些商品均由本地的厨师、手工艺者和种植者生产。

paragraphs.text: D Craft Festival Cardiff
paragraphs.translation: D 加的夫工艺节

paragraphs.text: Craft Festival Cardiff (formerly Made by Hand Cardiff) moved to City Hall, Cardiff in 2014. There is a range of bookable workshops for all ages. Our workshops are very popular and most sell out quickly. To book you must be over 16 years of age. We also have a range of free workshops for children between the ages of 2 and 18.
paragraphs.translation:
卡迪夫手工艺节（原名为“卡迪夫手工制作”）于2014年迁至卡迪夫市政厅。
这里有一系列可预订的工作坊，面向所有年龄段的人群。
我们的工作坊非常受欢迎，大多数很快就售罄了。
预订者必须年满16岁。
我们还有一系列免费工作坊，面向2至18岁的儿童。

paragraphs.text: E Sparks in the Park
paragraphs.translation: E 公园烟花秀

paragraphs.text: Our annual event enables up to 20,000 people to view one of the UK's largest firework displays, accompanied by live presenters from HeartFM radio, a full fun-fair, food and drinks stalls and a carnival atmosphere. Two displays will be taking place again this year: a children's firework display from 6 pm and Wales's largest firework display from 7 pm onwards. All funds raised will be distributed to organisations that help people in need.
paragraphs.translation:
我们的年度活动可容纳多达20,000人观赏英国最大的烟花表演之一，现场有HeartFM电台主持人的直播、完整的游乐场、食品和饮料摊位以及嘉年华氛围。
今年将再次举办两场表演：下午6点开始的儿童烟花表演，以及晚上7点开始的威尔士最大烟花表演。
所有筹集的资金将分配给帮助有需要人士的组织。

paragraphs.text: The benefits of taking an advanced driving course
paragraphs.translation: 参加高级驾驶课程的好处

paragraphs.text: Once you have passed the practical and theory components of the driving test and have your full driving licence, you may think you are an expert driver. However, there are lots of things you can do to improve your road skills, making you a safer and more competent driver.
paragraphs.translation:
一旦你通过了驾驶考试的实际操作和理论部分，并获得了正式驾照，你可能会认为自己是一名专家级的驾驶员。
然而，有很多方法可以提升你的驾驶技巧，从而让你成为一名更安全、更有能力的驾驶员。

paragraphs.text: What is an advanced driving course?
paragraphs.translation: 什么是高级驾驶课程？

paragraphs.text: The course gives you advanced feedback and guidance on your driving habits. The series of lessons provides you with the opportunity to learn additional skills that will help you to anticipate hazards when you are driving and turn you into a more systematic and disciplined road user.
paragraphs.translation:
该课程会针对你的驾驶习惯提供高层次的反馈与指导。
这一系列课程让你有机会学习额外技能，这些技能将帮助你驾驶时预判危险，并将你塑造成一个更有条理、更具纪律性的道路使用者。

paragraphs.text: Each available course differs in structure depending on the company that you choose to use. However, they all have the same goal. And as well as producing safer drivers, the advanced driving course may help reduce your fuel consumption and keep your car in better shape for longer.
paragraphs.translation:
每种可用课程的结构根据你选择使用的公司而有所不同。
然而，它们都有着相同的目的。
除了培养更安全的驾驶者外，高级驾驶课程还可能有助于降低你的燃油消耗，并使你的车辆保持更长时间的良好状态。

paragraphs.text: There are a few advanced driving courses you can choose from, depending on which driving skills you need to work on. Here are two examples:
paragraphs.translation:
你可以从几种高级驾驶课程中选择，具体取决于你需要提升哪些驾驶技能。
以下是两个例子：

paragraphs.text: lAM Roadsmart
paragraphs.translation: IAM Roadsmart

paragraphs.text: Once you have purchased the course, the company will match you with a local expert who will observe your driving habits over a series of lessons, The instructor will then give you personalised feedback which will help ensure that you are driving in the safest way possible.
paragraphs.translation:
一旦你购买了课程，公司会为你匹配一位当地专家，他会在系列课程中观察你的驾驶习惯。
随后，指导员会向你提供个性化的反馈，这有助于确保你以最安全的方式驾驶。

paragraphs.text: lAM Roadsmart offers a number of different advanced packages, including courses
paragraphs.translation:
IAM Roadsmart
lAM Roadsmart 提供多种不同的高级套餐，包括课程

paragraphs.text: intended for users of both cars and motorcycles.
paragraphs.translation: 适用于汽车和摩托车驾驶者。

paragraphs.text: The BAC
paragraphs.translation: BAC（英国汽车协会）

paragraphs.text: The BAC has a wide range of specialist courses suitable for every type of driver. If there are certain elements of road use that you find particularly challenging, such as driving at night or using rural roads, you will be able to find a course that is tailored to suit you. The BAC also has a course intended to help improve confidence for more general road use.
paragraphs.translation:
BAC（英国汽车协会）
BAC 提供一系列适合各类驾驶员的专业课程。
如果道路使用的某些方面让你觉得特别具有挑战性，例如夜间驾驶或使用乡村道路，你将能够找到一门为你量身定制的课程。
BAC 还开设了一门课程，旨在帮助提升更广泛道路使用中的自信心。

paragraphs.text: Prices vary depending on how many hours you wish to undertake and what you wish to practise, so it is best to contact the BAC directly for more information.
paragraphs.translation:
BAC（英国汽车协会）
价格根据您希望投入的学时以及想要练习的内容而有所不同，因此最好直接联系BAC以获取更多信息。

questions.prompt: It is advisable to reserve places for certain activities at this event.

questions.prompt: This event also takes place in another country.

questions.reason: 直接原文对应

questions.analysis: 题干中“listen to a range of singers here without paying”对应段落B中“over 30 free musical and cultural events, featuring incredible vocal performances”，其中“free”和“vocal performances”表明可以免费欣赏多位歌手的表演，因此答案为B。

questions.paraphrasing: listen to a range of singers without paying -> free musical and cultural events, featuring incredible vocal performances

wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文明确提到高级驾驶课程能教授省油技巧，与选项矛盾。

questions.prompt: lAM Roadsmart courses operate on a one-to-one basis.
questions.analysis: 题干中的“operate on a one-to-one basis”对应原文中“the company will match you with a local expert who will observe your driving habits”，说明每位学员会被分配一位专属专家进行指导，体现一对一教学模式，因此答案为TRUE。

questions.location_analysis: 原文描述匹配专家并观察驾驶习惯，暗示一对一教学，故选 TRUE。
questions.paraphrasing: one-to-one basis -> match you with a local expert who will observe your driving habits
evidence: the company will match you with a local expert who will observe your driving habits over a series of lessons,

wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文明确说明课程是一对一进行的，与选项内容矛盾。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文明确给出了一对一的信息，并非未提及。

questions.reason: 直接原文对应
questions.location_analysis: 原文还提供通用课程，否定只针对特定需求，故选 FALSE。

questions.keywords: only provides lessons to people who have particular driving requirements
evidence: The BAC also has a course intended to help improve confidence for more general road use.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 与原文矛盾，原文表明BAC提供的课程不仅限于有特定驾驶需求的人。

sentence_translations.sentence: Our annual event enables up to 20,000 people to view one of the UK's largest firework displays, accompanied by live presenters from HeartFM radio, a full fun-fair, food and drinks stalls and a carnival atmosphere.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们的年度活动可容纳多达20,000人观赏英国最大的烟花表演之一，现场有HeartFM电台主持人的直播、完整的游乐场、食品和饮料摊位以及嘉年华氛围。

sentence_translations.sentence: Two displays will be taking place again this year: a children's firework display from 6 pm and Wales's largest firework display from 7 pm onwards.
sentence_translations.translation: 今年将再次举办两场表演：下午6点开始的儿童烟花表演，以及晚上7点开始的威尔士最大烟花表演。

sentence_translations.sentence: All funds raised will be distributed to organisations that help people in need.
sentence_translations.translation: 所有筹集的资金将分配给帮助有需要人士的组织。

sentence_translations.sentence: The benefits of taking an advanced driving course
sentence_translations.translation: 参加高级驾驶课程的好处

sentence_translations.sentence: Once you have passed the practical and theory components of the driving test and have your full driving licence, you may think you are an expert driver.
sentence_translations.translation: 一旦你通过了驾驶考试的实际操作和理论部分，并获得了正式驾照，你可能会认为自己是一名专家级的驾驶员。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, there are lots of things you can do to improve your road skills, making you a safer and more competent driver.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，有很多方法可以提升你的驾驶技巧，从而让你成为一名更安全、更有能力的驾驶员。

sentence_translations.sentence: What is an advanced driving course?
sentence_translations.translation: 什么是高级驾驶课程？

sentence_translations.sentence: The course gives you advanced feedback and guidance on your driving habits.
sentence_translations.translation: 该课程会针对你的驾驶习惯提供高层次的反馈与指导。

sentence_translations.sentence: The series of lessons provides you with the opportunity to learn additional skills that will help you to anticipate hazards when you are driving and turn you into a more systematic and disciplined road user.
sentence_translations.translation: 这一系列课程让你有机会学习额外技能，这些技能将帮助你驾驶时预判危险，并将你塑造成一个更有条理、更具纪律性的道路使用者。

sentence_translations.sentence: Each available course differs in structure depending on the company that you choose to use.
sentence_translations.translation: 每种可用课程的结构根据你选择使用的公司而有所不同。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, they all have the same goal.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，它们都有着相同的目的。

sentence_translations.sentence: And as well as producing safer drivers, the advanced driving course may help reduce your fuel consumption and keep your car in better shape for longer.
sentence_translations.translation: 除了培养更安全的驾驶者外，高级驾驶课程还可能有助于降低你的燃油消耗，并使你的车辆保持更长时间的良好状态。

sentence_translations.sentence: There are a few advanced driving courses you can choose from, depending on which driving skills you need to work on.
sentence_translations.translation: 你可以从几种高级驾驶课程中选择，具体取决于你需要提升哪些驾驶技能。

sentence_translations.sentence: Here are two examples:
sentence_translations.translation: 以下是两个例子：

sentence_translations.sentence: lAM Roadsmart
sentence_translations.translation: IAM Roadsmart

sentence_translations.sentence: Once you have purchased the course, the company will match you with a local expert who will observe your driving habits over a series of lessons,
sentence_translations.translation: 一旦你购买了课程，公司会为你匹配一位当地专家，他会在系列课程中观察你的驾驶习惯。

sentence_translations.sentence: The instructor will then give you personalised feedback which will help ensure that you are driving in the safest way possible.
sentence_translations.translation: 随后，指导员会向你提供个性化的反馈，这有助于确保你以最安全的方式驾驶。

sentence_translations.sentence: lAM Roadsmart offers a number of different advanced packages, including courses
sentence_translations.translation: lAM Roadsmart 提供多种不同的高级套餐，包括课程

sentence_translations.sentence: intended for users of both cars and motorcycles.
sentence_translations.translation: 适用于汽车和摩托车驾驶者。

sentence_translations.sentence: The BAC
sentence_translations.translation: BAC（英国汽车协会）

sentence_translations.sentence: The BAC has a wide range of specialist courses suitable for every type of driver.
sentence_translations.translation: BAC 提供一系列适合各类驾驶员的专业课程。

sentence_translations.sentence: If there are certain elements of road use that you find particularly challenging, such as driving at night or using rural roads, you will be able to find a course that is tailored to suit you.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果道路使用的某些方面让你觉得特别具有挑战性，例如夜间驾驶或使用乡村道路，你将能够找到一门为你量身定制的课程。

sentence_translations.sentence: The BAC also has a course intended to help improve confidence for more general road use.
sentence_translations.translation: BAC 还开设了一门课程，旨在帮助提升更广泛道路使用中的自信心。

sentence_translations.sentence: Prices vary depending on how many hours you wish to undertake and what you wish to practise, so it is best to contact the BAC directly for more information.
sentence_translations.translation: 价格根据您希望投入的学时以及想要练习的内容而有所不同，因此最好直接联系BAC以获取更多信息。

paragraphs.text: HOW TO APPLY FOR A JOB ONLINE
paragraphs.translation: 如何在线申请工作

paragraphs.text: How do l start an application?
paragraphs.translation: 我该如何开始申请？

paragraphs.text: Once you've found a post in the Current Vacancies that you'd like to apply for and viewed the job description, click the Apply Now tab below. Then you will be presented with a screen that asks you to create a new account. Scroll down the section that says First Time Applicant to enter your email address, which is used to create your account. You also have to agree to the data collection policy before an application form will appear on screen.
paragraphs.translation:
一旦你在当前职位空缺中找到想要申请的职位并查看了职位描述，请点击下方的“立即申请”标签。
随后，屏幕会要求你创建一个新账户。
向下滚动至标有“首次申请者”的部分，输入你的电子邮件地址，该地址将用于创建账户。
你还必须同意数据收集政策，之后申请表才会在屏幕上显示。

paragraphs.text: How do l fill the application form in?
paragraphs.translation: 我该如何填写申请表？

paragraphs.text: The form has a series of tabs at the top, with names such as Personal Details, Education, etc. These are split up to enable you to work on small sections of the application at any one time. Every time you click a tab, the data is saved. You can also alter your application at any point and then click Save Changes at the bottom of the form.
paragraphs.translation:
表格顶部有一系列选项卡，名称包括“个人详情”、“教育”等。
这些选项卡被分拆开来，以便您随时处理申请的各个小部分。
每次点击一个选项卡时，数据都会被保存。
您也可以在任何时候修改申请，然后点击表格底部的“保存更改”。

paragraphs.text: Some sections of the application form are required information. These will be indicated with an asterisk (*).
paragraphs.translation:
申请表格的某些部分是必填信息。
这些部分会以星号 (*) 标示。

paragraphs.text: When you have finished, click the Complete tab. You then type your name (this is instead of a signature) and click Submit. You will be asked to confirm that you really want to submit your application.
paragraphs.translation:
当你完成时，点击“完成”选项卡。
然后输入你的姓名（这代替签名），并点击“提交”。
你会被要求确认是否真的想要提交你的申请。

paragraphs.text: Can I save my application and come back and work on it later?
paragraphs.translation: 我可以保存我的申请，稍后再回来继续填写吗？

paragraphs.text: The application does not need to be completed in one sitting. When you sign up for the first time, you will be sent the password for your account, You can use this to log in and continue your application. Click the login link; there will be an option on the left called My Applications. This contains a list of your applications that are in progress at the current time.
paragraphs.translation:
申请不需要一次性全部完成。
当你首次注册时，你将收到账户密码，
你可以使用该密码登录并继续你的申请。
点击登录链接；
左侧会有一个名为“我的申请”的选项。
这里面列出了你当前正在进行的所有申请。

paragraphs.text: How do l apply for more than one vacancy at the same time?
paragraphs.translation: 我如何同时申请多个职位？

paragraphs.text: You will need to submit an application form to the recruitment office for every position you are interested in being considered for. Please do not submit one application form to apply for a number of different posts.
paragraphs.translation:
你需要为每一个你感兴趣并希望被考虑的职位，向招聘办公室提交一份申请表。
请不要仅提交一份申请表来申请多个不同的职位。

parts.title: Passage 3
parts.article_title: WIND POWER - A TURN FOR THE BETTER

paragraphs.text: In an effort to find alternative sources of energy, some governments have turned to wind power as a possible solution. However, this has proved controversial, as Steve Rose reports.
paragraphs.translation:
为了寻找替代能源，一些政府已转向风能作为一种可能的解决方案。
然而，正如史蒂夫·罗斯报道的那样，这已被证明是存在争议的。

paragraphs.text: A Think of wind power and the first image to spring to mind is most likely a giant, three-bladed propeller spinning atop a slim tower, probably in a rural area. Chances are that's actually the only image that springs to mind - and that's the problem.
paragraphs.translation:
提到风能，首先映入脑海的很可能是乡村地区细长塔顶上旋转的巨大三叶片螺旋桨。
很可能这实际上就是唯一浮现的画面——而这正是问题所在。

paragraphs.text: B To renewable-energy supporters, wind turbines symbolise the hope of a green, clean future, but to opponents, they might as well be invaders from outer space. In the UK, with plans for new wind farms proceeding apace in an effort to meet the government's interim target for renewable-sourced energy, the debate has reached crisis point. Anti-wind farm groups have been springing up wherever wind farms are proposed; some opponents say they would rather have a nuclear power station in their backyard than see the rural landscape covered in propellers on sticks. And as long as propellers on sticks are the only option, pro- and anti-wind farm camps are unlikely ever to agree. The debate is clearly as much about the aesthetics of wind power as the politics and practicalities but, at present, wind turbines barely rank above electricity pylons in terms of aesthetic consideration, Members of the design community are, however, rising to the challenge.
paragraphs.translation:
对于可再生能源的支持者来说，风力涡轮机象征着绿色、清洁未来的希望，但对反对者而言，它们无异于来自外太空的入侵者。
在英国，为了达成政府的可再生能源中期目标，新风电场的建设计划迅速推进，使得这场辩论已陷入危机时刻。
凡是提议建设风电场的地方，反风电场团体便会如雨后春笋般涌现；一些反对者表示，他们宁愿自家后院有座核电站，也不愿看到乡村景观被遍布的杆上螺旋桨覆盖。
只要杆上螺旋桨还是唯一的选择，支持和反对风电场的阵营就几乎不可能达成一致。
这场辩论显然既关乎风电的政治和实用性，也关乎其美学价值；但目前，风力涡轮机在美学考量上的地位几乎不比电线塔高。然而，设计界的成员正在迎接这一挑战。

paragraphs.text: C One of the most striking projects rethinks the idea of the turbine entirely. It is called an Aerogenerator and it looks nothing like a propeller on a stick. The Aerogenerator, designed by Grimshaw Architects, is arguably the first wind turbine design to capture the spirit of pioneering optimism that these structures sought to express. It could also be a very practical option, especially since it would be situated offshore, far away from anyone's backyard. While conventional turbines rotate on a horizontal axis, the tall, V-shaped Aerogenerator spins on a vertical axis, like a record, Unlike horizontal-axis designs, vertical-axis turbines can harness wind energy from any direction, and because the moving parts and the generator are at ground level, they are easier to maintain.
paragraphs.translation:
最引人注目的项目之一彻底重新思考了涡轮机的概念。
它被称为航空发电机，看起来完全不像杆上的螺旋桨。
由格里姆肖建筑师事务所设计的航空发电机，可以说是首个捕捉到这些结构试图表达的开拓性乐观精神的风力涡轮机设计。
它也可能是一个非常实用的选择，尤其是因为它将位于海上，远离任何人的后院。
传统涡轮机在水平轴上旋转，而高耸的V形航空发电机在垂直轴上旋转，像唱片一样。与水平轴设计不同，垂直轴涡轮机可以从任何方向利用风能，而且由于活动部件和发电机位于地面水平，它们更易于维护。

paragraphs.text: D 'Our engineer thought about the problems with traditional turbines and developed a new design, says Theo Bird, founder of Windpower Ltd., who is funding this new Aerogenerator project through a combination of a government grant and the money he was saving to buy a new house. 'By making our turbine so large, we can build offshore, where there's more wind. It's got to be something strong and simple to work at sea. And in the future, you could possibly double the power from each turbine by harnessing tidal power beneath the surface of the sea,' 'Also,' adds Bird, 'we saw it as a striking landmark that could enhance the entrance of a harbour or an industrial port."
paragraphs.translation:
“我们的工程师思考了传统涡轮机的问题，并开发了一种新设计，”风力发电有限公司创始人西奥·伯德说。他通过政府拨款和自己原本计划购买新房子的积蓄共同资助了这个新的气动发电机项目。
“通过将涡轮机制造得如此之大，我们可以在风力更强的海上进行建设。
它必须坚固且简单，才能在海上运作。
未来，通过利用海面下的潮汐能，你或许可以将每个涡轮机的发电量翻倍。”伯德补充道，“我们也将其视为一个引人注目的地标，可以提升港口或工业港口的入口形象。”

paragraphs.text: E Beyond making more attractive wind farms, there is also potential for integrating turbines directly into buildings. After all, if nobody wants wind turbines in the countryside why not put them in the cities? Cities already have high-rise structures in which to incorporate turbines that would be in tune with a man-made environment, Added to this, there would be less need to transport the electricity large distances to its users.
paragraphs.translation:
除了建设更具吸引力的风力发电场之外，还有可能将涡轮机直接整合到建筑物中。
毕竟，如果没有人希望在乡村安装风力涡轮机，为什么不把它们安置在城市里呢？
城市已经拥有高层建筑，可以融入与人工环境相协调的涡轮机，此外，这也减少了将电力远距离输送给用户的需求。

paragraphs.text: F It took a long time for architects to successfully incorporate effective wind turbines into buildings, The architect Richard Rogers proposed an integral turbine for the Tomigaya Tower in Tokyo in 1993, but his plan was turned down. In more recent efforts, such as William Pedersen's sports centre in New York, wind turbines seem to be environmentally friendly but do not provide a real solution to energy requirements.
paragraphs.translation:
F 建筑师们花了很长时间才成功地将高效的风力涡轮机融入建筑物中，
建筑师理查德·罗杰斯于1993年为东京的富谷塔提出了一个整体涡轮机方案，但他的计划被拒绝了。
在更近期的尝试中，例如威廉·佩德森在纽约设计的体育中心，风力涡轮机看似环保，却并未为能源需求提供真正的解决方案。

paragraphs.text: G Going a step further, several years ago a European Commission-sponsored organisation named Project WEB (Wind Energy for the Built Environment investigated in detail the possibility of constructing a purpose-built wind-powered skyscraper, According to Project WEB's environmental engineer, Sinisa Stankovic, under the right circumstances such a building could generate nearly all of its own energy needs. Yet despite the proven effectiveness of Project WEB's designs (which also included a four-tower design that could harness wind from any direction), the realities of the construction industry kept them on the drawing board.
paragraphs.translation:
更进一步来说，多年前，一个由欧盟委员会资助、名为“建筑环境风能项目”的组织详细研究了建造一座专门设计的风力发电摩天大楼的可能性。
据该项目环境工程师辛尼萨·斯坦科维奇所言，在适当条件下，这样一座建筑几乎可以满足其自身所有的能源需求。
然而，尽管该项目设计（还包括一种可从任何方向利用风能的四塔设计）的有效性已得到证实，但建筑行业的现实情况使其仍停留在设计阶段。

paragraphs.text: H A project that came closer to realisation was the controversial Freedom Tower in New York. At the top of this enormous tower, architects intended to create a 150 m-high open cage structure containing a wind turbine. The skyscraper beneath it was shaped to channel the wind up into it, and it could have generated a quarter of the building's needs - a genuine urban wind farm. Despite this design receiving widespread approval, other factors came to take precedence over environmental considerations. So instead of a powerful advertisement for wind power's potential to the world, the Freedom Tower became a rather ordinary office block. Guy Battle, a much respected expert in the field of environmental and sustainable architecture, was consulting engineer for the project.
paragraphs.translation:
H 一个更接近实现的项目是纽约备受争议的自由塔。
在这座巨大建筑的顶部，建筑师计划建造一个150米高的开放式笼状结构，其中包含一座风力涡轮机。
其下方的摩天大楼被设计成引导风向上的形状，本可满足该建筑四分之一的需求——堪称真正的城市风电场。
尽管这一设计获得广泛认可，但其他因素最终凌驾于环境考量之上。
因此，自由塔未能成为向世界展示风能潜力的有力象征，反而变成了一栋相当普通的办公楼。
备受尊敬的环境与可持续建筑领域专家盖伊·巴特尔担任该项目的咨询工程师。

paragraphs.text: I As energy from fossil fuels becomes more scarce and expensive, the energy performance of buildings can only increase in importance. ‘Traditional buildings have been a drain on infrastructure-water, electricity, waste disposal, etc.’ says Battle, ‘It's no longer about just responding to cultural and social urban factors. It's a whole different layer of architecture coming through that will begin to change the face of our cities.’
paragraphs.translation:
随着化石燃料能源变得越来越稀缺和昂贵，建筑的能源性能只会变得更加重要。
“传统建筑一直是基础设施——水、电、废物处理等方面的消耗，”巴特尔说，“这不再仅仅是对文化和社会城市因素的回应。这是一个全新的建筑层面正在浮现，它将开始改变我们城市的面貌。”

parts.source_article_title: WIND POWER - A TURN FOR THE BETTER

sentence_translations.sentence: In an effort to find alternative sources of energy, some governments have turned to wind power as a possible solution.
sentence_translations.translation: 为了寻找替代能源，一些政府已转向风能作为一种可能的解决方案。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, this has proved controversial, as Steve Rose reports.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，正如史蒂夫·罗斯报道的那样，这已被证明是存在争议的。

sentence_translations.sentence: A Think of wind power and the first image to spring to mind is most likely a giant, three-bladed propeller spinning atop a slim tower, probably in a rural area.
sentence_translations.translation: 提到风能，首先映入脑海的很可能是乡村地区细长塔顶上旋转的巨大三叶片螺旋桨。

sentence_translations.sentence: Chances are that's actually the only image that springs to mind - and that's the problem.
sentence_translations.translation: 很可能这实际上就是唯一浮现的画面——而这正是问题所在。

sentence_translations.sentence: To renewable-energy supporters, wind turbines symbolise the hope of a green, clean future, but to opponents, they might as well be invaders from outer space.
sentence_translations.translation: 对于可再生能源的支持者来说，风力涡轮机象征着绿色、清洁未来的希望，但对反对者而言，它们无异于来自外太空的入侵者。

sentence_translations.sentence: In the UK, with plans for new wind farms proceeding apace in an effort to meet the government's interim target for renewable-sourced energy, the debate has reached crisis point.
sentence_translations.translation: 在英国，为了达成政府的可再生能源中期目标，新风电场的建设计划迅速推进，使得这场辩论已陷入危机时刻。

sentence_translations.sentence: Anti-wind farm groups have been springing up wherever wind farms are proposed; some opponents say they would rather have a nuclear power station in their backyard than see the rural landscape covered in propellers on sticks.
sentence_translations.translation: 凡是提议建设风电场的地方，反风电场团体便会如雨后春笋般涌现；一些反对者表示，他们宁愿自家后院有座核电站，也不愿看到乡村景观被遍布的杆上螺旋桨覆盖。

sentence_translations.sentence: And as long as propellers on sticks are the only option, pro- and anti-wind farm camps are unlikely ever to agree.
sentence_translations.translation: 只要杆上螺旋桨还是唯一的选择，支持和反对风电场的阵营就几乎不可能达成一致。

sentence_translations.sentence: The debate is clearly as much about the aesthetics of wind power as the politics and practicalities but, at present, wind turbines barely rank above electricity pylons in terms of aesthetic consideration, Members of the design community are, however, rising to the challenge.
sentence_translations.translation: 这场辩论显然既关乎风电的政治和实用性，也关乎其美学价值；但目前，风力涡轮机在美学考量上的地位几乎不比电线塔高。然而，设计界的成员正在迎接这一挑战。

sentence_translations.sentence: One of the most striking projects rethinks the idea of the turbine entirely.
sentence_translations.translation: 最引人注目的项目之一彻底重新思考了涡轮机的概念。

sentence_translations.sentence: It is called an Aerogenerator and it looks nothing like a propeller on a stick.
sentence_translations.translation: 它被称为航空发电机，看起来完全不像杆上的螺旋桨。

sentence_translations.sentence: The Aerogenerator, designed by Grimshaw Architects, is arguably the first wind turbine design to capture the spirit of pioneering optimism that these structures sought to express.
sentence_translations.translation: 由格里姆肖建筑师事务所设计的航空发电机，可以说是首个捕捉到这些结构试图表达的开拓性乐观精神的风力涡轮机设计。

sentence_translations.sentence: It could also be a very practical option, especially since it would be situated offshore, far away from anyone's backyard.
sentence_translations.translation: 它也可能是一个非常实用的选择，尤其是因为它将位于海上，远离任何人的后院。

sentence_translations.sentence: While conventional turbines rotate on a horizontal axis, the tall, V-shaped Aerogenerator spins on a vertical axis, like a record, Unlike horizontal-axis designs, vertical-axis turbines can harness wind energy from any direction, and because the moving parts and the generator are at ground level, they are easier to maintain.
sentence_translations.translation: 传统涡轮机在水平轴上旋转，而高耸的V形航空发电机在垂直轴上旋转，像唱片一样。与水平轴设计不同，垂直轴涡轮机可以从任何方向利用风能，而且由于活动部件和发电机位于地面水平，它们更易于维护。

sentence_translations.sentence: D 'Our engineer thought about the problems with traditional turbines and developed a new design, says Theo Bird, founder of Windpower Ltd., who is funding this new Aerogenerator project through a combination of a government grant and the money he was saving to buy a new house.
sentence_translations.translation: “我们的工程师思考了传统涡轮机的问题，并开发了一种新设计，”风力发电有限公司创始人西奥·伯德说。他通过政府拨款和自己原本计划购买新房子的积蓄共同资助了这个新的气动发电机项目。

sentence_translations.sentence: 'By making our turbine so large, we can build offshore, where there's more wind.
sentence_translations.translation: “通过将涡轮机制造得如此之大，我们可以在风力更强的海上进行建设。

sentence_translations.sentence: It's got to be something strong and simple to work at sea.
sentence_translations.translation: 它必须坚固且简单，才能在海上运作。

sentence_translations.sentence: And in the future, you could possibly double the power from each turbine by harnessing tidal power beneath the surface of the sea,' 'Also,' adds Bird, 'we saw it as a striking landmark that could enhance the entrance of a harbour or an industrial port."
sentence_translations.translation: 未来，通过利用海面下的潮汐能，你或许可以将每个涡轮机的发电量翻倍。”伯德补充道，“我们也将其视为一个引人注目的地标，可以提升港口或工业港口的入口形象。”

sentence_translations.sentence: E Beyond making more attractive wind farms, there is also potential for integrating turbines directly into buildings.
sentence_translations.translation: 除了建设更具吸引力的风力发电场之外，还有可能将涡轮机直接整合到建筑物中。

sentence_translations.sentence: After all, if nobody wants wind turbines in the countryside why not put them in the cities?
sentence_translations.translation: 毕竟，如果没有人希望在乡村安装风力涡轮机，为什么不把它们安置在城市里呢？

sentence_translations.sentence: Cities already have high-rise structures in which to incorporate turbines that would be in tune with a man-made environment, Added to this, there would be less need to transport the electricity large distances to its users.
sentence_translations.translation: 城市已经拥有高层建筑，可以融入与人工环境相协调的涡轮机，此外，这也减少了将电力远距离输送给用户的需求。

sentence_translations.sentence: F It took a long time for architects to successfully incorporate effective wind turbines into buildings,
sentence_translations.translation: F 建筑师们花了很长时间才成功地将高效的风力涡轮机融入建筑物中，

sentence_translations.sentence: The architect Richard Rogers proposed an integral turbine for the Tomigaya Tower in Tokyo in 1993, but his plan was turned down.
sentence_translations.translation: 建筑师理查德·罗杰斯于1993年为东京的富谷塔提出了一个整体涡轮机方案，但他的计划被拒绝了。

sentence_translations.sentence: In more recent efforts, such as William Pedersen's sports centre in New York, wind turbines seem to be environmentally friendly but do not provide a real solution to energy requirements.
sentence_translations.translation: 在更近期的尝试中，例如威廉·佩德森在纽约设计的体育中心，风力涡轮机看似环保，却并未为能源需求提供真正的解决方案。

sentence_translations.sentence: G Going a step further, several years ago a European Commission-sponsored organisation named Project WEB (Wind Energy for the Built Environment investigated in detail the possibility of constructing a purpose-built wind-powered skyscraper,
sentence_translations.translation: 更进一步来说，多年前，一个由欧盟委员会资助、名为“建筑环境风能项目”的组织详细研究了建造一座专门设计的风力发电摩天大楼的可能性。

sentence_translations.sentence: According to Project WEB's environmental engineer, Sinisa Stankovic, under the right circumstances such a building could generate nearly all of its own energy needs.
sentence_translations.translation: 据该项目环境工程师辛尼萨·斯坦科维奇所言，在适当条件下，这样一座建筑几乎可以满足其自身所有的能源需求。

sentence_translations.sentence: Yet despite the proven effectiveness of Project WEB's designs (which also included a four-tower design that could harness wind from any direction), the realities of the construction industry kept them on the drawing board.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，尽管该项目设计（还包括一种可从任何方向利用风能的四塔设计）的有效性已得到证实，但建筑行业的现实情况使其仍停留在设计阶段。

sentence_translations.sentence: H A project that came closer to realisation was the controversial Freedom Tower in New York.
sentence_translations.translation: H 一个更接近实现的项目是纽约备受争议的自由塔。

sentence_translations.sentence: At the top of this enormous tower, architects intended to create a 150 m-high open cage structure containing a wind turbine.
sentence_translations.translation: 在这座巨大建筑的顶部，建筑师计划建造一个150米高的开放式笼状结构，其中包含一座风力涡轮机。

sentence_translations.sentence: The skyscraper beneath it was shaped to channel the wind up into it, and it could have generated a quarter of the building's needs - a genuine urban wind farm.
sentence_translations.translation: 其下方的摩天大楼被设计成引导风向上的形状，本可满足该建筑四分之一的需求——堪称真正的城市风电场。

sentence_translations.sentence: Despite this design receiving widespread approval, other factors came to take precedence over environmental considerations.
sentence_translations.translation: 尽管这一设计获得广泛认可，但其他因素最终凌驾于环境考量之上。

sentence_translations.sentence: So instead of a powerful advertisement for wind power's potential to the world, the Freedom Tower became a rather ordinary office block.
sentence_translations.translation: 因此，自由塔未能成为向世界展示风能潜力的有力象征，反而变成了一栋相当普通的办公楼。

sentence_translations.sentence: Guy Battle, a much respected expert in the field of environmental and sustainable architecture, was consulting engineer for the project.
sentence_translations.translation: 备受尊敬的环境与可持续建筑领域专家盖伊·巴特尔担任该项目的咨询工程师。

sentence_translations.sentence: As energy from fossil fuels becomes more scarce and expensive, the energy performance of buildings can only increase in importance.
sentence_translations.translation: 随着化石燃料能源变得越来越稀缺和昂贵，建筑的能源性能只会变得更加重要。

sentence_translations.sentence: ‘Traditional buildings have been a drain on infrastructure-water, electricity, waste disposal, etc.’ says Battle, ‘It's no longer about just responding to cultural and social urban factors. It's a whole different layer of architecture coming through that will begin to change the face of our cities.’
sentence_translations.translation: “传统建筑一直是基础设施——水、电、废物处理等方面的消耗，”巴特尔说，“这不再仅仅是对文化和社会城市因素的回应。这是一个全新的建筑层面正在浮现，它将开始改变我们城市的面貌。”
